Satchu Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Reza Satchu is a Senior Lecturer in the Entrepreneurship Management Unit at the Harvard Business School where he teaches The Founder Mindset and Founder Launch, two courses that he created, as well as The Entrepreneurial Manager . He is also the Founder, Managing Partner and majority shareholder of Alignvest Management Corporation and the Founding Chairman of NEXT Canada.
